name: relai-mods
description: Needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.308). RelAI Mods: /relai-mods opens a cockpit of the mods, plugins and settings.json hooks on this machine, read from disk in folded groups, each with its scope, version, state and details. A switch turns one plugin on or off through the claude CLI on PATH; Reload reloads the plugins in the terminal and on the desktop asks you to type /reload-plugins. Hooks, policy-managed plugins and the cockpit itself are locked. The row 'RelAI w tym projekcie' above the list turns RelAI and its three add-ons on or off in the session folder (claude plugin --scope local, after a Yes/No card) and adds .claude/settings.local.json to .worktreeinclude, the only file the cockpit writes itself. Never writes settings.json or installed_plugins.json; no model call, no network of its own.
